item.title: They Who? It’s You
item.author: kasthuri.r7903@gmail.com (Kasthuri Rengarajan)
item.description:
This is my first published poem — a reflection on fear, regret, and finding guidance within ourselves.

It’s ok to have fear; It’s ok to not feel ok. We’ve got big dreams hidden in the clouds of uncertainty.

But why do our dreams turn into fear? Because we are in a rush. Don’t chase—ATTRACT, they say.

Grief harms too. You cannot run away from it. Feel it, but don’t drown in it, they say.
